text:
The change adds invoice charging and retries when receipt delivery cannot reach the mail service. The retry also repeats the payment, creating a blocking risk of duplicate charges.

`charge()` posts a new payment without an idempotency key. If payment succeeds but `sendReceipt()` throws `Unreachable`, the next attempt charges the customer again. Three failed receipt attempts can therefore produce three charges before the function throws. Charge once before the retry loop and reuse that charge ID for receipt retries.

The checkout contains no tests covering this failure path.
